gist.summary: Fixed the Polli CLI README’s publishable app-key command so its line continuation works when pasted. Updated the Hermes guide to use `polli mcp install hermes --all`, and fixed the endpoint-agent curl sample so its multiline command displays correctly. Bumped `@pollinations/cli` from 0.1.48 to 0.1.49 with the corrected README.
